## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +0.17%) but XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -5.53%) and mixed risk signals (VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -4.79%)) confirm a balanced, mixed market.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit and rates broadly neutral with HYG RECOVERY (1W: +0.32% | 1M: -0.14%) and LQD RECOVERY (1W: +0.02% | 1M: -2.04%). Volatility easing as VXX BELOW TREND supports risk tolerance while TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -3.82%) signals upward pressure on yields.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral overall: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -3.82%) and HYG RECOVERY (1W: +0.32% | 1M: -0.14%) point to tighter yield-driven conditions but no acute stress; credit spreads remain flat in the data.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals leading: XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%) and XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +2.28%); Tech mixed with XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -5.53%). Style: Value/cyclicals showing relative strength versus Growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US steady with SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +0.17%); China outperformance via FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.55% | 1M: +14.17%). EM mixed as EEM RECOVERY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -3.60%) shows short-term bounce but lagging 1M.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative flows mixed: IBIT in CORRECTION (1W: -1.95% | 1M: +4.82%) while ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -12.96%) signals constrained risk-taking; small caps IWM RECOVERY (1W: +0.01% | 1M: -2.71%) is tepid.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad commodity strength over 1M with divergence: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +6.32%) while oil ETFs (BNO (1W: -4.18% | 1M: +27.84%) and USO (1W: -5.50% | 1M: +25.08%)) are in CORRECTION. Gold in CORRECTION (GLD (1W: -0.10% | 1M: +0.25%))—profit taking rather than a trend reversal.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +12.76%) and BNO CORRECTION (1W: -4.18% | 1M: +27.84%) show 1M strength but near-term pullback, while UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -12.67%) remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad sector participation with SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +0.17%) and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +6.32%). DIVERGENCE: Commodities show multiple CORRECTION signals (BNO, USO, UGA) and Tech fragility (XLK BELOW TREND) — minor-to-moderate divergence, not a core regime break.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and China exposure given XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%) and FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.55% | 1M: +14.17%); reduce exposure to Tech as XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -5.53%). Monitor bond yields (TLT BELOW TREND) and commodity corrections for volatility triggers.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Financials XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%) and Consumer Discretionary XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +2.28%). BEARISH: Utilities XLU BELOW TREND (sector data: Utilities 1W: -4.44% | 1M: -0.16%) and Biotech XBI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.31% | 1M: -6.09%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +6.32%) as an industrial-cycle read. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -12.67%) and oil near-term CORRECTION in BNO (1W: -4.18% | 1M: +27.84%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency/watch); HYG/LQD spread ~ watch for widening as a credit signal; XLK/ XLF relative around the current pivot (XLK BELOW TREND vs XLF ABOVE TREND) to signal a style turn.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive.  
China (FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.55% | 1M: +14.17%)) and cyclicals (XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%); XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +2.28%)) showing relative strength.  
Key risk is tech weakness (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -5.53%)) and commodity/energy divergences (BNO CORRECTION (1W: -4.18% | 1M: +27.84%)) to monitor.
